pages.title: Music Charms
pages.text: A tamed snake unlocks a musical interaction and useful output.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Play a note block or jukebox nearby, then offer rabbit during its dance state. The bottle needs an actual native bite result; effect contents are not promised without inspecting the output.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Tame a dancing snake with raw rabbit and collect its bitten-bottle output. Play a note block or jukebox nearby, then offer rabbit during its dance state. The bottle needs an actual native bite result; effect contents are not promised without inspecting the output.
